app_note: Silicon dioxide helps powdered foods resist clumping.
risk_note: Used in small amounts as a flow aid.

app_note: Calcium silicate absorbs moisture and helps powders pour more easily.
risk_note: Usually appears in dry powdered foods.

app_note: Magnesium carbonate can reduce clumping in dry ingredient blends.
risk_note: Also contributes magnesium in small amounts.

app_note: Tricalcium phosphate can act as both a flow aid and a calcium-containing ingredient.
risk_note: Phosphate and calcium roles should be separated in the app display.

app_note: Cellulose powder is plant-derived fiber used for texture flow and anti-caking.
risk_note: It is not digested like starch or sugar.

app_note: Microcrystalline cellulose is refined plant cellulose used for structure and flow.
risk_note: Best explained as a texture and carrier ingredient.

app_note: Maltodextrin often carries flavors and improves powder texture.
risk_note: It is a digestible carbohydrate and not a low-calorie fiber.

app_note: Dextrins are short starch fragments used for texture binding or carrying flavors.
risk_note: Source crop may be corn wheat potato or tapioca.

app_note: Glycerin helps foods stay moist and soft.
risk_note: Can be plant animal or synthetic depending supplier.

app_note: Propylene glycol can carry flavors and help manage moisture in some foods.
risk_note: Do not confuse with ethylene glycol; they are different substances.

app_note: Polydextrose adds bulk and fiber-like texture with less sweetness than sugar.
risk_note: Large amounts can affect digestion for some people.

app_note: Sorbitol syrup helps keep foods moist and adds mild sweetness.
risk_note: Large amounts may have digestive effects.

app_note: Inulin is a soluble fiber often extracted from chicory root.
risk_note: Can cause gas or bloating for some people.

app_note: Soluble corn fiber is used to add fiber and body to processed foods.
Oat fiber is mostly insoluble fiber used for texture and fiber labeling.
risk_note: It is different from oat flour or whole oats.

app_note: Wheat fiber adds structure and fiber to baked foods.
risk_note: Wheat allergen and gluten-free status must be checked carefully.
